features.heading: Key Features
features.subtitle: Ten capabilities that run the whole club, end to end

items.title: Role-Aware Dashboards
items.desc: Tailors every menu and screen to 14 roles, enforced by a shared permissions map across the sidebar and server-side route guard.

items.title: Multi-Sport & Multi-Team
items.desc: Manages first and reserve squads across football, basketball, handball and more, with sport-specific rules wired throughout.

items.title: Real Competitions
items.desc: Builds league tables and knockout brackets and pulls live standings and fixtures from real leagues via football-data.org.

items.title: Live-Match Engine
items.desc: Runs a live clock with goals, cards, substitutions and a full event timeline, scoring penalties and shoot-outs per sport.

items.title: Injury Lifecycle
items.desc: Tracks each player from diagnosis through treatment, rehab and recovery to a fitness test, flipping availability automatically.

items.title: Plan-Driven Training
items.desc: Schedules drill-based sessions and tracks per-player attendance, drill ratings and session completion against the calendar.

items.title: Scouting & Sponsorship
items.desc: Files sign-or-pass scout reports on prospects and negotiates sponsor offers with pending, stale and accepted states.

items.title: Real-Time Messaging
items.desc: Delivers club-wide group chat over a live socket with reactions, replies and read receipts, falling back to polling.

items.title: Analytics & ML Predictions
items.desc: Aggregates team, player and training KPIs and serves ML-powered match-outcome predictions and 0-100 player ratings.

items.title: Live Notifications
items.desc: Surfaces injuries, goals, transfers, contract expiries and report-ready events in a top-bar bell and full alerts center.

problems.heading: Problem Definition
problems.subtitle: Why a multi-sport club drowns without a unified platform

items.title: Scattered Tooling
items.desc: Splinters club operations across spreadsheets, WhatsApp threads and paper forms, with no shared system.

items.title: Manual Match Ops
items.desc: Forces staff to log line-ups, events and scores by hand, inviting delays and human error.

items.title: Blind Injury Tracking
items.desc: Records injuries in isolation, with no link to player availability or selection decisions.

items.title: No Single Truth
items.desc: Leaves standings, squads and fixtures duplicated and contradictory across teams and sports.

items.title: Role-Blind Access
items.desc: Exposes sensitive data through shared logins, with no per-role permissions or audit trail.

items.title: Zero Analytics
items.desc: Offers no performance insights or match-outcome predictions to guide tactical choices.

items.title: Unplanned Training
items.desc: Schedules sessions ad hoc, with no attendance, drill rating or training-load tracking.

items.title: Slow Deal Flow
items.desc: Drags scouting reports and sponsor negotiations through disconnected emails and back-and-forth.

goals.heading: Project Goals
goals.subtitle: What Sportify set out to achieve

items.title: Unify Club Operations
items.desc: Consolidates matches, medical, training, scouting, messaging and finance into one role-aware platform.

items.title: Run Matches Live
items.desc: Streams each fixture in real time with an accurate, minute-by-minute event timeline and live clock.

items.title: Drive Injury Recovery
items.desc: Guides every injury from diagnosis through rehab to a final passing fitness test before return-to-play.

items.title: Anchor a Single Source of Truth
items.desc: Makes the Spring Boot back-end the authoritative store for real fixtures, results and league standings.

items.title: Enforce Secure Access
items.desc: Applies Keycloak-backed role-based access control across every service, route and action.

items.title: Surface Predictive Insights
items.desc: Delivers performance analytics and ML-driven predictions to inform line-up, scouting and tactics.

solutions.heading: Solutions: Traditional vs. Technological
solutions.subtitle: How Sportify replaces the old club playbook with a cloud-native one

items.title: Spreadsheets → Cloud Platform
items.desc: Replaces scattered, siloed spreadsheets with one unified cloud-native platform that centralizes every workflow.

items.title: Paper Files → Digital Journey
items.desc: Turns loose paper medical records into a staged digital injury lifecycle tied to each player's profile.

items.title: No Live Ops → Match Engine
items.desc: Upgrades silent match days into a broadcast-style live engine streaming events, line-ups and a running clock.

items.title: Manual Standings → Real Data
items.desc: Swaps hand-typed tables for live standings and fixtures ingested automatically from the football-data.org API.

items.title: Open Access → RBAC
items.desc: Ends 'everyone sees everything' by enforcing Keycloak role-based access across players, staff and managers.

items.title: Gut Feel → Analytics & ML
items.desc: Replaces instinct with data dashboards and a Python ML service that predicts outcomes and player insights.

roles.heading: Roles & Access
roles.subtitle: Eleven role surfaces across every dashboard route

items.title: Administrator
items.desc: Key Access: every dashboard route, including admin-only User Management. • Primary Functions: manages all accounts and roles and oversees the platform with unrestricted access.

items.title: Sport Manager
items.desc: Key Access: Club Hub, Teams, Staff, Players, Matches, Scouting, Contracts and Sponsors. • Primary Functions: runs a sport end-to-end, from squad and staff to transfers and sponsor deals.

items.title: Team Manager
items.desc: Key Access: Club Hub, Teams, Staff, Players, Training, Matches, Contracts, Reports. • Primary Functions: coordinates a team's roster, training schedule, fixtures and contract logistics.

items.title: Head Coach
items.desc: Key Access: Players, Teams, Training, Matches, Medical, Analytics, Reports, Alerts. • Primary Functions: leads coaching, sets up training and line-ups, and reviews performance and fitness.

items.title: Doctor
items.desc: Key Access: Medical (Injuries, Diagnoses, Treatments), Players, Training and Alerts. • Primary Functions: diagnoses each injury and prescribes its treatment, opening the player's medical case and driving the early stages of the injury cycle.

items.title: Physiotherapist
items.desc: Key Access: Medical (Rehabilitation, Recovery), Players and Training. • Primary Functions: builds and manages the rehabilitation plans and tracks each player's recovery progress back toward full fitness.

items.title: Fitness Coach
items.desc: Key Access: Training, Fitness Tests, Players and Analytics. • Primary Functions: creates, assigns and tracks fitness tests, clearing a recovering player for return-to-play only once a final fitness test is passed.

items.title: Performance Analyst
items.desc: Key Access: Analytics, Training Analytics, Reports, Matches, Players and the ML Predictor & Rating tools. • Primary Functions: analyzes match and training data and runs AI predictions and ratings.

items.title: Scout
items.desc: Key Access: Scouting & Scouting Ops, Players, Matches, Competitions, Head-to-Head, Reports. • Primary Functions: tracks and evaluates prospects, logging scouting reports against players and fixtures.

items.title: Player
items.desc: Key Access: read-only Club Hub, Players, Matches, Competitions and Head-to-Head, plus the player's own Training and Medical. • Primary Functions: follows the club and a personal schedule, viewing fixtures, results, assigned training sessions and personal medical and fitness status in a focused, view-only surface.

items.title: Fan
items.desc: Key Access: Club Hub, Trophy Room, Competitions, Matches and Head-to-Head, plus the Club Store, the Auctions house and the News Feed. • Primary Functions: the public face of the platform. Browses club news, squads, fixtures and live results; follows competitions and the trophy room; engages with the fan community; shops the official store; and bids against other fans in live auctions for exclusive, signed memorabilia.

architecture.heading: System Architecture
architecture.subtitle: A cloud-native Spring Cloud microservice mesh behind one JWT-secured gateway

items.title: Next.js Front-End
items.desc: Serves the React dashboard and talks to the platform through a single API Gateway origin.

items.title: Spring Cloud Gateway
items.desc: Verifies Keycloak JWTs and load-balances every request to the right service on port 8080.

items.title: Six Domain Services
items.desc: Splits into user (8081), player (8084), training-match (8087), medical (8086), reports (8083) and notification (8085), each with a private database.

items.title: Eureka + Config
items.desc: Registers services in Eureka (8761) and feeds them centralized settings from the Config Server (8082).

items.title: Keycloak Identity
items.desc: Issues and signs OAuth2 tokens for the mscms realm that every service validates as a resource server.

items.title: Kafka Event Backbone
items.desc: Streams domain events asynchronously via an outbox publisher so notifications and analytics never block.

items.title: FastAPI ML Engine
items.desc: Exposes Python match-prediction and player-rating models that the gateway routes to under /ml.

items.title: football-data.org Feed
items.desc: Pulls real La Liga and Champions League fixtures and standings on a scheduled sync into the match service.

training.heading: Plan-Driven Training
training.subtitle: From season plan to scored session, one squad at a time

items.title: Training Plans
items.desc: Anchors one plan to a single team and sport, with a start-to-end date range, training type, goals and focus that every session inherits.

items.title: Scheduled Sessions
items.desc: Places each session at its own date and time inside the plan's range, then lists them in chronological order with a done count.

items.title: Ordered Drills
items.desc: Stamps each drill with a category, duration and sequence, and rejects the session if the drills' total minutes reach the session length.

items.title: Squad Attendance
items.desc: Records a per-player status and offers only non-injured players who belong to that plan's team for call-up.

items.title: Drill Ratings
items.desc: Rates every drill 1-10 once the session time has passed, averaging them into a score that marks the session completed.

items.title: Four-Tier Model
items.desc: Cascades the Plan → Sessions → Drills → Attendance hierarchy so deleting a parent cleanly removes its children.

medical.heading: Advanced Injury Management
medical.subtitle: A medically-governed return-to-play pipeline, from first report to cleared

items.title: Staged Injury Lifecycle
items.desc: Drives every injury through REPORTED → DIAGNOSED → TREATING → RECOVERING → RECOVERED as the status that gates each next action.

items.title: Single Source of Truth
items.desc: Makes the medical service the one authority on availability, so card, stepper and squad all read the same status.

items.title: Auto-Removal When Injured
items.desc: Pulls an injured player out of match line-ups, training and attendance the moment the injury is logged, and notifies the team.

items.title: Mandatory Fitness Test
items.desc: Requires a passing return-to-play fitness test before the player flips to RECOVERED and is restored as AVAILABLE.

items.title: Treatment Room & Catalog
items.desc: Runs the per-player recovery journey from a reusable library of injury types, diagnoses, treatments, rehab and tests.

items.title: Unified Medical Profile
items.desc: Consolidates each player's injuries, treatments, rehab, recovery and fitness records into one progress-tracked case view.

matches.heading: Live-Match Engine
matches.subtitle: A broadcast-style match-day cockpit that runs the game minute by minute

items.title: Phase State Machine
items.desc: Walks every match through scheduled → first half → half time → second half → full time, auto-going-live at kickoff.

items.title: Phase-Bound Events
items.desc: Records goals, cards, subs and injuries against a live clock, clamping each event's minute to the phase in play.

items.title: Knockout Decider
items.desc: Triggers two extra-time periods and an alternating penalty shoot-out only when a true knockout tie is still level.

items.title: Live Persistence
items.desc: Streams every score change, event and status flip to the training-match service so the timeline survives a reload.

items.title: Formation-First Line-up
items.desc: Builds the starting XI on a drag-and-drop pitch, persisting formation, match and line-up rows together.

items.title: Result Write-Back
items.desc: At full time it pushes the final score back to the source fixture and fires alerts, feeding standings and analytics.

competitions.heading: Real Competitions
competitions.subtitle: Live football brought into the club — real tables, real brackets, one source of truth

items.title: La Liga Live
items.desc: Shows live La Liga standings and fixtures, with results that update automatically as matches are played.

items.title: New-Format Champions League
items.desc: Renders the redesigned UCL as one 36-team league-phase table with qualification zones, then unlocks the knockout bracket.

items.title: World Cup 2026
items.desc: Presents the 48-team World Cup across 12 group tables and a knockout bracket, seeding the qualified teams into the Round of 32 when the draw is TBD.

items.title: Head-to-Head
items.desc: Builds FC Barcelona's all-time win-draw-loss record, goals and win-rate against every opponent from finished matches.

items.title: Real Data, One Source
items.desc: Ingests genuine fixtures and results from football-data.org into the back-end, which stays the single source of truth.

items.title: Club Hub & Trophy Room
items.desc: Wraps it in the FC Barcelona Club Hub and a multi-sport Trophy Room cabinet of curated historical honours.

future.heading: Future Work
future.subtitle: Where Sportify goes next: mobile, ML and the wider sporting world

items.title: Native Mobile Apps
items.desc: Ships dedicated iOS and Android apps with push notifications so staff and players manage the club on the move.

items.title: Deeper ML Models
items.desc: Extends the Python ML service with richer predictions fed by live in-match features, not just pre-game stats.

items.title: More Sports & Federations
items.desc: Expands the multi-sport engine with new disciplines and official federation data feeds beyond football-data.org.

items.title: Wearables & Biometrics
items.desc: Integrates wearables to stream training-load and biometric data straight into player medical and fitness profiles.

items.title: Live Video & Streaming
items.desc: Attaches live video and clip streaming to the match timeline so every key event links to its footage.
